title: CallMeMaybeVia: no ClientDisco/AddrPorts validation -> attacker-directed UDP reflection/amplification + client-side handshake resource exhaustion
severity: HIGH (DDoS reflection/amplification to arbitrary internet addresses from the victim node + client DoS). Default-on preconditions.
status: VERIFIED by code read: dispatch checks relayClientEnabled+relayCapable+known-peer+disco but NOT via.ClientDisco membership and does NOT cap via.AddrPorts; handshakeServerEndpoint loops over every AddrPort calling sendDiscoMessage.
component: wgengine/magicsock/magicsock.go (CallMeMaybeVia dispatch ~2331-2416), relaymanager.go handleCallMeMaybeVia (:448) + handshakeServerEndpoint (AddrPorts send loop)
preconditions: attacker is any peer known to victim over DERP advertising capver>=121 (relayCapable is self-advertised, NOT ACL-gated); victim relayClientEnabled is DEFAULT-ON (true unless DisableRelayClient/OnlyTCP443). No peercap required.
mechanism: one CallMeMaybeVia over DERP carries attacker-chosen ServerDisco, VNI, and AddrPorts (bounded only by DERP MaxPacketSize 64KiB -> ~thousands of AddrPorts). handshakeServerEndpoint fires a Geneve+disco Bind to EACH AddrPort -> victim emits N outbound UDP packets to attacker-chosen (incl. off-tailnet) addresses. Distinct ServerDisco/VNI spawn distinct concurrent handshake goroutines+ECDH -> CPU/goroutine/memory exhaustion.
impact: 1:thousands packet fan-out reflection with the victim as source (DDoS primitive to arbitrary internet IP:ports); sustained -> client resource exhaustion DoS.
fix: validate via.ClientDisco includes self before handshaking; cap AddrPorts; cap concurrent handshake works per peer.
